conventions.column: {label, field, mandatory, mandatory_when, note, ...}. label = exact header text (default_feild_name). field = internal field name (feild_name). The importer resolves headers by SLUG (Maatwebsite HeadingRowFormatter "slug": lowercase, punctuation dropped, spaces->_), so label matching is case/space/punctuation-insensitive; slug(label) must equal an importer field name (EndrosementDumpImport.php:32, 60-186).
conventions.mandatory: true = required on every row by the validators. false = never unconditionally required. If mandatory_when is non-null the column is required only in that case. seed_is_mandatory is the raw is_mandatory flag in the seeder; it is NOT enforced anywhere in the endorsement import (EndrosementDumpImport::rules() returns [] at line 617; grep shows no use of is_mandatory in the add/remove/update pipeline).
conventions.variants: variant "default" is the full seeded column list. Other variants are OVERLAYS ({extends:default}) listing only columns whose requirement/note changes for that policy shape. Header sets do not change with policy type/rater/IPD-OPD/TPA; only mandatory-ness, dropdown options and 3 conditionally-removed columns do.
conventions.order: Default sample order = ORDER BY sequence ASC (SampleFileController.php:481-486). Many rows share a sequence number; the tie order is then DB-defined (UNKNOWN). Lists here are sorted by (sequence, seeded id).
conventions.present_when: always | portal-gated (tenant/deployment Portal::check) | conditional on policy data. Portal gating means the legacy build had per-tenant column sets; the rebuild must decide which tenant it models.

DefaultEndrosementFormat.50: Multi Employer (no row in format seeder; used by MultiEmployerPolicySampleFieldSeeder)

caveats: Custom per-policy / per-broker / per-employer templates (custom_bulk_upload_templates + template_fields, CustomFormatController.php:12-60) replace the default header list at download time. Their rows live only in the database - header sets for those are UNKNOWN. The importer maps custom labels back to feild_name via slug(label) (EndrosementDumpImport.php:88-102).

getNewTataFields() (helper.php:9068-9097, 48 names) are excluded from every default sheet (e.g. member_middle_name, marital_status, work_location, passport_no, visa_*). They exist only in the Tata "two-column" seeders (AdditionEndorsementTwoColumnMappingSeeder.php / CorrectionEndorsementTwoColumnMappingSeeder.php) and in multi-policy sheet 40.

Header-name quirks that are load-bearing: "Endrosement Number" (typo), "Inception/Endorsement Date" (slug inceptionendorsement_date), "Add/delete" (slug adddelete handled specially in EndorsementDumpImportJob.php:179,224-226).
